summary: A work that shares its normalized title and publication year with a retracted work in the same result is marked retracted-twin and excluded from the score.
reason: DetectRetraction sees one work at a time, so a second copy of a retracted paper without a DOI or index flag was scored. Measured on 'vitamin D reduces fractures' --limit 25: a DOAJ copy of 10.2147/tcrm.s43811 (flagged retracted in OpenAlex) was counted as supporting at confidence 0.95.
validated_outcome: Same query after the fix: retracted_excluded 2 -> 3, study_count 23 -> 22, supporting 14 -> 13; the DOAJ copy carries retraction retracted-twin. Declared and flagged statuses are never overwritten; Year 0 and empty normalized titles never give or receive the mark. Detection runs on the fetched works before the relevance gate, so a twin the gate drops still marks its relevant copy.
